_meta.note: Canonical schema for .planning/config.json. Source of truth for keys, types, enums, and defaults. Validated by bin/config.mjs; the cad-config workflow catalog is derived from this. Enum provenance: [repo] = pinned in DESIGN/references; [proposed] = plausible label the executing model honors, no runtime validator beyond membership.
_meta.types: bool | int | string | string_or_null | enum | array_string | array_enum. int accepts an optional 'min'. enum/array_enum carry 'values'.

granularity.purpose: How many phases the roadmap gets - new-project roadmap step only (coarse 3-5 / standard 5-8 / fine 8-12 phases); it splits no phase into tasks

stakes.purpose: What a break in this project costs - the question routing asks, rather than what a dispatch costs. solo = nobody else runs this, a break costs only my time; shipped = other people run this, a break comes back as a bug report; critical = a break is not a bug report

model.escalate_on_failure.purpose: Re-dispatch a failed attempt at the retry rung the role's own routing cell names; false holds the retry at the rung it started on

model.overrides.cad-planner.purpose: Pin the planner to one model alias, bypassing the stakes matrix (null = route normally). The only way to reach `fable`, which stays pin-only: reaching it is a user assertion about their own org (it needs 30-day data retention, and its classifiers refuse cyber-adjacent review work), not a rung on this ladder

model.overrides.cad-assumptions-analyzer.purpose: Pin the assumptions analyzer to one model alias (null = route normally)

model.overrides.cad-verifier.purpose: Pin the verifier to one model alias (null = route normally)

model.overrides.cad-reviewer.purpose: Pin the claude-subagent reviewer to one model alias (null = route normally)

model.overrides.cad-executor.purpose: Pin the executor to one model alias (null = route normally)

model.overrides.cad-plan-checker.purpose: Pin the plan checker to one model alias (null = route normally); the rung escalation still applies

model.effort.cad-planner.purpose: The rung the planner STARTS at, replacing the one its routing cell names (null = route normally off the cell). Only a rung this role actually has is accepted; any other value is refused, naming the allowed set. The risk floor does not reach this role: it dispatches BEFORE the phase PLAN whose declared paths the floor reads, so the configured rung always wins over the cell

risk.override.auth.purpose: Waive the detected risk floor for the `auth` surface ALONE (auth/authn/authz, sessions, permissions): a phase whose plan declares one of its paths stops being raised on that account. Every OTHER detected surface still floors the phase. Honoured from the repo config layer only: a waiver written to the user-global layer is ignored and named in the resolver's warnings - unless both layer paths resolve to ONE file (a symlink, or CADENCE_GLOBAL_CONFIG aimed at this repo's own config), where there is a single layer, it is the repo layer, and the waiver holds.

workflow.research.purpose: Run a research pass - new-project research step only; no other workflow reads it

workflow.plan_check.purpose: Gate plans through the checker before code

workflow.verifier.purpose: The off switch for goal-backward verification after a phase: false always skips the deep pass. When true the stakes level decides whether it runs (--deep forces it either way)

workflow.skip_discuss.purpose: Select which command /cad-progress suggests for an unplanned phase - progress next-step suggestion only; it skips no step

workflow.subagent_timeout.purpose: ms before a subagent is killed

workflow.inline_plan_threshold.purpose: Task count at/below which a plan runs inline vs its own doc

workflow.test_command.purpose: Command Cadence runs to test (null = none)

workflow.lint_command.purpose: Command an executor runs for static analysis before it commits (null = none set, so planning.mjs detect-commands reads the project's own manifests instead). LINT ONLY - there is no companion typecheck key; the detected arm covers both

parallelization.enabled.purpose: Run independent plans concurrently. On by default; false is the intentional opt-out. Engages only when the plans are provably independent AND the host's worktree.baseRef is "head" - choose_path falls back to sequential otherwise, so the default is safe on a host that cannot honour it

parallelization.use_worktrees.purpose: Isolate parallel writes in git worktrees

git.protected_branches.purpose: Branches Cadence won't commit to directly

git.on_protected.purpose: What to do on a protected branch (DESIGN §5, git rails)

git.integration_branch.purpose: Two-tier branch model: 'milestone' creates a per-milestone integration branch as the branch worktrees merge back into (where they fork FROM is the host's worktree.baseRef setting); 'trunk' creates no integration branch and commits land on the base governed by on_protected

git.auto_branch.purpose: How the integration branch is created at cycle start: 'ask' prompts once, 'auto' creates/switches silently, 'off' stays put

git.base_branch.purpose: Branch new work branches off (null = current)

git.on_land_cleanup.purpose: After a successful land/merge, return to the base branch, pull, and reap the merged integration branch

git.auto_close.purpose: Opt-in end-to-end close: cad-milestone/cad-land run audit -> tag -> PR -> merge -> reset with no per-step prompts, halting on a blocking pre_ship FAIL. Honoured repo config layer only for the unattended publish: that close applies to ONE repository, so a user-global value authorizes no push (D-08, git-publish.mjs repoAutoClose). The land gate reads the MERGED value on purpose - cad-land suppresses the pre_ship triage ask on that same merged value, so the gate's blocker/high halt is what replaces the human it switched off, and both must read one value.

memory.backend.purpose: Where notes/observations route: 'builtin' runs zero-dep BM25 recall over .planning/, 'none' disables recall

review.key_file.purpose: Path override for the provider key env file (never a key)

review.request_timeout_ms.purpose: ms before a review provider HTTPS request is aborted (a high-effort review can take minutes); 600000 is the execution-host ceiling

review.max_prompt_tokens.purpose: Estimated-token ceiling (chars/4) on a review or consult payload; an over-cap payload is refused with ok:false, reason over-cap before any request is issued; cross-model provider calls only - the free claude-subagent reviewer never runs that script

review.providers.openai.tiers.flagship.purpose: OpenAI model id for the flagship tier (set by --review)

review.providers.openai.tiers.balanced.purpose: OpenAI model id for the balanced tier

review.providers.openai.tiers.cheap.purpose: OpenAI model id for the cheap tier

review.providers.gemini.tiers.flagship.purpose: Gemini model id for the flagship tier

review.providers.gemini.tiers.balanced.purpose: Gemini model id for the balanced tier

review.providers.gemini.tiers.cheap.purpose: Gemini model id for the cheap tier

review.providers.deepseek.tiers.flagship.purpose: DeepSeek model id for the flagship tier

review.providers.deepseek.tiers.balanced.purpose: DeepSeek model id for the balanced tier

review.providers.deepseek.tiers.cheap.purpose: DeepSeek model id for the cheap tier

review.triggers.plan.tier.purpose: Model tier for plan review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's model comes from the routing cell

review.triggers.plan.effort.purpose: Reasoning effort for plan review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's effort is frontmatter-frozen

review.triggers.diff.tier.purpose: Model tier for diff review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's model comes from the routing cell

review.triggers.diff.effort.purpose: Reasoning effort for diff review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's effort is frontmatter-frozen

review.triggers.risk_surface.tier.purpose: Model tier for risk-surface review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's model comes from the routing cell

review.triggers.risk_surface.effort.purpose: Reasoning effort for risk-surface review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's effort is frontmatter-frozen

review.triggers.pre_ship.tier.purpose: Model tier for pre-ship review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's model comes from the routing cell

review.triggers.pre_ship.effort.purpose: Reasoning effort for pre-ship review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's effort is frontmatter-frozen

review.triggers.phase_diff.gate.purpose: Opt-in aggregate review of the merged phase diff after parallel execution (per-plan reviews never see cross-plan interactions)

review.triggers.phase_diff.tier.purpose: Model tier for the merged-phase review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's model comes from the routing cell

review.triggers.phase_diff.effort.purpose: Reasoning effort for the merged-phase review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's effort is frontmatter-frozen

review.consult.enabled.purpose: Allow a second-model consult at dead-ends

review.consult.attempt_threshold.purpose: Failed fix attempts (or red-test iterations) on one bug before cad-debug offers a consult

review.decision_review.tier.purpose: Model tier for /cad-decision-review's refute-then-adjudicate pass - cross-model reviewers only; its claude-subagent arm is cad-reviewer at the session default and resolves no model at all

review.decision_review.effort.purpose: Reasoning effort for /cad-decision-review - cross-model reviewers only; the claude-subagent reviewer's effort is frontmatter-frozen
